product: Back model provider service credentials with a Unity Catalog secret
tagline: Back a model provider service's API key with a customer owned Unity Catalog secret.
what_it_does: Back a model provider service's API key with a customer owned Unity Catalog secret. The service reads it at query time, so rotating the secret takes effect with no service change. Register an external model provider as a model provider service, grant access to it, configure Unity Gateway features, and delete it.
